tasks.title: Rename helpers to double/halve with alias exports
tasks.intent: In lib/util.mjs, rename doubleInternal(n) to double(n) and halveInternal(n) to halve(n) leaving the bodies unchanged (n * 2, n / 2), and add alias exports doubleInternal = double and halveInternal = halve so old importers keep working. Both renames land in this single task because they write to the same file and are trivially small.

tasks.title: Extend tests with new-name assertions
tasks.intent: Extend tests/util.test.mjs by adding assertions that double(4) === 8 and halve(4) === 2 and that the old names alias the new functions, while keeping the existing old-name assertions and test untouched so the pre-existing coverage of RF-C01 keeps running.

tasks.title: Run existing suite for alias constraint
tasks.intent: Run the RF-C01-A acceptance command node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0. This executes the repository's pre-existing tests/util.test.mjs (which imports doubleInternal/halveInternal) plus the extended assertions, verifying the aliases remain exported and behavior is unchanged.

observations.statement: lib/util.mjs exports doubleInternal and halveInternal only; tests/util.test.mjs is the repository's sole test file and imports both old names, so it is the existing-behavior coverage for RF-C01.

RF-001-A and RF-002-A are file-content acceptance on lib/util.mjs, and RF-C01-A is the command node --test on tests/*.test.mjs with expected exit 0; all three are runtime-executable, so no additional acceptance is needed.
